question: If 10\% of 30\% of (2)/(3) of a number is 537, find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all into fraction: 10% = 1/10, 30% = 3/10

So total fraction = (1/10) × (3/10) × (2/3) = 1/50

Given 1/50 of number = 537

⇒ Number = 537 × 50

**∴ Answer = 26850**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10% of 30% of (2/3) of a number = 537

**Formula used:**

Percentage = value/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ (10/100) × (30/100) × (2/3) × x = 537

⇒ (1/10) × (3/10) × (2/3) × x = 537

⇒ (1/50) × x = 537

⇒ x = 537 × 50

⇒ x = 26850

**∴ The correct answer is 26850.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

x% = x/100. Helps simplify chained percentage problems quickly.

Successive Percentage

Multiple percentages multiply: a% of b% of x = (a/100 × b/100) × x.

Fraction Simplification

Cancel common factors early to reduce calculation steps.

Reverse Calculation

If a fraction of a number is given, multiply to get the original value.
